nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Evenin', stranger. Quiet town, ain't it?

choices.text: What am I up to again?

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Church bell ain't rung since the mine shut. Walk under it and give it a clang, would ya? There's {gold_offer} dollars in it.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: End of the street, past the windmill. Can't miss it.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Heard it clear across town. That's {gold} dollars to your name now. Obliged.
